summary: Expired tickets accepted unrelated viewer codes
failure_scenario: An expired ticket remained in the table; redeeming an unrelated or empty code could return the panel token.

summary: Path checks do not confine writes against adversarial ancestor swaps
failure_scenario: An untrusted account replaces a shared ancestor after resolved-root validation, redirecting a later pathname operation outside configured roots.
reason: Descriptor-relative confinement across save/create/rename/Trash needs a separate architecture change; shared ancestors must remain trusted. Independent pragmatic review rejected a recanonicalization workaround.

summary: A remote platform value could select an unintended upload source
failure_scenario: An outdated helper reports an absolute or traversal platform path, causing the bridge to choose a file outside packaged helper targets.

summary: Queued terminal text lacked a fresh pane and shell check
failure_scenario: A queued command reaches the same iTerm2 session after its tmux pane or foreground shell changes, typing into the wrong pane or busy job.

summary: Remote tmux workspace keys collided across SSH destinations
failure_scenario: Two hosts report the same short hostname, socket and pane id; switching between them reuses one workspace and can retain the wrong file scope.

summary: Pending viewer paths lost their machine identity
failure_scenario: A remote viewer request queued before its page connected could be drained as a local path or consumed by another host viewer.

summary: The bootstrap installer accepted an older signed release as latest
failure_scenario: A signed older manifest and matching archive were replayed to a user with a newer numbered release already installed.

summary: Removed or replaced connections could register again during teardown
failure_scenario: Remove races a successful connection or backend re-registration; a stale owner republishes the removed host or unlinks a replacement socket.

summary: Conditional saves were not serialized with competing mutations
failure_scenario: Two saves with one etag both succeeded, or rename/Trash ran during save publication and the save recreated an obsolete path.

summary: Rename could overwrite a destination created after preflight
failure_scenario: Another writer creates the destination between the existence check and ordinary rename; its contents are silently replaced.

summary: Concurrent workspace flushes shared a temporary file and stale snapshots
failure_scenario: Overlapping flushes interleave one temporary pathname or allow an older snapshot to publish after a newer workspace.

summary: Request-level Trash failure discarded unsaved buffers
failure_scenario: A failed request produced a synthetic empty-path error; the panel treated selected paths as successes and removed dirty documents.

summary: Save completion and conflict retries did not follow a renamed document
failure_scenario: Rename while saving, then Overwrite or Reload: the old path could be recreated, or the renamed editor could be marked clean with obsolete metadata.

summary: Closing a tab after Save could discard edits typed during the request
failure_scenario: The user types additional edits while a close-triggered Save waits; successful saving of the earlier snapshot still closes the dirty tab.

summary: Late document reads and decisions could cross host boundaries
failure_scenario: A delayed file read, link prefetch or conflict choice completes after a host switch and replaces or discards a same-path document on the new host.

summary: Late rename/create replies changed the newly focused workspace
failure_scenario: A rename request from host A completes after switching to B and rebases B’s dirty document, selection or persisted workspace.

summary: Agent record transactions could overwrite other host updates
failure_scenario: Concurrent enable/remove/update threads read the same record, then publish separate mutations, losing enabled hosts or restoring removed entries.

summary: Remote helper copies used shared staging paths
failure_scenario: Two Macs copy different helpers to one host simultaneously; shared temporary binary/link paths mix their installations.

summary: Lossy filename decoding created actionable aliases
failure_scenario: An invalid UTF-8 filename decodes to the same display path as a legitimate replacement-character filename; an action can address the wrong entry.

summary: Obsolete workspace restoration could replace the current root and tabs
failure_scenario: A canceled pane restoration or an older same-pane GET completes last and replaces the newer workspace.
